approach: Moving to static recompilation of the PC (Windows, x86) executable to native ARM64 with a D3D9-to-Vulkan layer; the Xbox 360 XEX recompilation (own kernel/XAM runtime, RexGlue Vulkan backend) is the current working build
help: x86 PE static recompilation (x87, SEH, indirect calls)
notes: Xbox 360 build is playable on Android ARM64 (Lenovo Legion Y700 Gen 4, Adreno 830), 20-30 FPS, GPU-bound by Xenos EDRAM emulation. Work is shifting to a native recompilation of the DRM-free PC release for 60 FPS, resolution and FOV options; the PC part is at the analysis stage. You must supply your own copy of the game; no game files are included.
